title: 9Velo 2025 Road Disc Carbon Spoke CD Wide Series 20H/20H
notes: Official store, USD. CD58 Wide (model year 2025): 58 mm depth, 24 mm inner and 30 mm outer width, hooked, tubeless/clincher compatible with a drilled rim bed, 700x28-47c tires, 20/20 carbon spokes, 9Velo T17 straight-pull hub with 36T ratchet (45T option), Center Lock, 12x100/12x142, steel bearings, 120 kg system weight limit, 1,323 g ±30 g with alloy Shimano freehub and without tubeless tape. CD58 Wide variants were US$1,289 with 36T and US$1,329 with 45T ratchets (titanium freehub +US$80) for Shimano HG, SRAM XDR, Campagnolo 11/12-speed or N3W freehubs. Limited 2-year warranty for original owners excluding bearings, spokes and nipples; non-quality returns pay return shipping and import tax. No maximum tire pressure is published. Photo: the CD58 Wide variant image with CD 58 and 622x24 rim decals.
